items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. You told me and Betty Rankin told me she came to the parade.

ctx.x: But it was all right after a while because this English trumpet player, Clive, he managed to outplay Baptiste a little bit. He played loud and that was the only way to get Baptiste to quit playing on a few choruses. So we managed to get him to play some other songs instead of singing the blues all the time. So it sounded a lot too bad. It sounded a lot better than the other time I played with him. It was about the week before. What was that, the Jolly Bunches?
Yeah. You played in Maryland I understand yesterday. Yeah. You told me and Betty Rankin told me she came to the parade.
Yeah. It was kind of hard for me to play that horn. It's the wrong system for me and the wrong keys and everything.
